name: sk-model-picker
title: Model Picker
description: Model selection in plain language: every row carries a subtitle saying what the trade is and a badge for fast, balanced or powerful, with the raw identifier kept in monospace for the people who want it. Locked models are shown rather than hidden, because a model the user cannot reach is the most persuasive upgrade prompt an AI app has.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKModelPicker(models: models, selection: $model)
SKModelPicker(models: models, selection: $model, style: .list)
